page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-2x.8xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn8v server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 6.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates dedicated hardware acceleration, featuring two GPUs with a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the inclusion of dual GPUs with substantial VRAM alongside dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores, this instance represents a high-density hardware profile tailored for specialized workloads. It is qualitatively optimized for GPU-accelerated tasks such as machine learning training, deep learning inference, data science pipelines, and complex parallel computing workloads that require significant video memory but do not rely on high-speed local scratch storage.
